name: gemini
info: a smart (well, not really) ai assistant right in the chat
description:
### bot access
gemini has access to bot commands, so it can, for example, calculate large numbers via javascript. commands will be executed on your behalf!

### limitations
a user has 100,000 internal tokens per day. once these are used up, they will need to wait a day for them to regenerate. in the future, there will be a command to view how many tokens a user has used
